info.name: SecureVault - 08 - Security and Authorization Testing
info.description: Source-mapped manual API lab for the existing 3-mangal backend. All writes, email sends and credential reads require armed_request equal to their TC ID and consume that setting once. Mail-sending cases require verified Mailpit mode. See POSTMAN_TEST_GUIDE.md. No live test has been executed by importing this file.

request.description:
TC150 · Expected HTTP 401. Authentication: none.



Execution: select this one request and set armed_request=TC150 (not required for this read).

exec: const spec = {"folder":7,"id":"TC150","name":"Reject missing account authentication","method":"GET","path":"/api/account/me","status":[401],"auth":"none","shape":"error","requestName":"TC150 Reject missing account authentication [READ]"};
const text = value => typeof value === "string" ? value : String(value || "");
if (value === undefined || value === null || text(value) === "") stop();
if (typeof value === "string") return value.replace(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => text(key === "future_expiry" ? pm.variables.get(key) : get(key)));
if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, expand(item)]));
pm.test("Safe rejected-operation response", () => pm.expect(typeof j.code === "string" && typeof j.message === "string").to.equal(true));
if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.entries(value).every(([key,item]) => !(forbidden.has(key) && item != null && item !== "") && clean(item));
pm.test("Metadata/error response exposes no secret values", () => pm.expect(clean(j)).to.equal(true));
